english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for opinions, attitudes, plans, or other things that can readily change.

examples.english: This plan is still malleable, so we can discuss it again if anyone has new opinions.
examples.traditional: 呢個計劃仲容易改變，大家有新意見都可以再傾。
